item.title: From 'The Old Man' to 'Giant,' John Lithgow discusses his recent iconic roles
item.description: Lithgow recently played an intelligence agent in The Old Man and starred in the Broadway production of Giant. He plays Dumbledore in a new HBO Harry Potter series. Originally broadcast April 2, 2026.

item.title: How the Steadicam sprinted up the stairs along with Rocky
item.description: A new movie about the making of Sylvester Stallone's 1976 film Rocky opens nationwide this week. It made him a star and helped revolutionize cinematography — including technology still used today.

item.title: Judges have put Trump's arch and golf course on hold, but only for a matter of days
item.description: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

item.title: 'Huna' writer wins National Book Award for non-fiction, after not being allowed into the U.S.
item.description: Abdelrahman ElGendy published a recent essay about being denied a visa to enter the U.S. for the ceremony. His book is a memoir about his time as a political prisoner in Egypt.

item.title: For opera's Anthony Roth Costanzo, singing countertenor is a joyful catharsis
item.description: Costanzo is a countertenor — a man who can sing in the range of female voices. He sings opera and a Hawaiian song in our studio, and talks about his new memoir, which includes a history of castrati.
